issue.subject: [tools][infra][qem-bot] "xml.etree.ElementTree.ParseError: syntax error: line 1, column 0: ." in gitea_sync
issue.description:
## Observation
From https://gitlab.suse.de/qa-maintenance/bot-ng/-/jobs/5991958#L106

```
2026-01-26 12:36:42 INFO     PR git:1767 skipped: No reviews by qam-openqa
2026-01-26 12:36:43 ERROR    Gitea API error: Unable to process PR git:1897
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/builds/qa-maintenance/bot-ng/qem-bot/openqabot/loader/gitea.py", line 515, in make_submission_from_gitea_pr
    add_packages_from_files(submission, token, files, dry=dry)
    ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/builds/qa-maintenance/bot-ng/qem-bot/openqabot/loader/gitea.py", line 446, in add_packages_from_files
    add_packages_from_patchinfo(submission, token, raw_url, dry=dry)
    ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/builds/qa-maintenance/bot-ng/qem-bot/openqabot/loader/gitea.py", line 437, in add_packages_from_patchinfo
    patch_info = osc.util.xml.xml_fromstring(retried_requests.get(patch_info_url, verify=False, headers=token).text)
  File "/usr/lib/python3.13/site-packages/osc/util/xml.py", line 112, in xml_fromstring
    return ET.fromstring(text)
           ~~~~~~~~~~~~~^^^^^^
  File "/usr/lib64/python3.13/xml/etree/ElementTree.py", line 1348, in XML
    parser.feed(text)
    ~~~~~~~~~~~^^^^^^
xml.etree.ElementTree.ParseError: syntax error: line 1, column 0: .
2026-01-26 12:36:44 INFO     PR git:1726 skipped: No reviews by qam-openqa
2026-01-26 12:36:45 INFO     PR git:1687 skipped: No reviews by qam-openqa
```

*not* a regression from https://github.com/openSUSE/qem-bot/pull/349 as https://gitlab.suse.de/qa-maintenance/bot-ng/-/jobs/5991830#L46 also shows it for ff5179e6ef87805ecc75c3f1b84e567b6de8e44f
